def_en: The main software that controls a computer.
example_en: Windows is an operating system.
example_es: Windows es un sistema operativo.

def_en: Specialized operating systems designed to manage network resources, files, and multi-user security.
example_en: A network operating system manages many users at the same time.
example_es: Un sistema operativo en red gestiona muchos usuarios a la vez.

def_en: The programs that run on a computer.
example_en: The software needs an update.
example_es: El software necesita una actualización.

def_en: A program that does a specific task.
example_en: This application opens PDF files.
example_es: Esta aplicación abre archivos PDF.

def_en: A new version of a program that fixes problems.
example_en: Install the latest update today.
example_es: Instala hoy la última actualización.

def_en: A copy of your files that you keep in case you lose the originals.
example_en: Make a backup before you format the disk.
example_es: Haz una copia de seguridad antes de formatear el disco.

def_en: A harmful program that damages files or steals data.
example_en: The antivirus found a virus on the laptop.
example_es: El antivirus encontró un virus en el portátil.

def_en: A program that finds and removes viruses.
example_en: Keep your antivirus updated.
example_es: Mantén tu antivirus actualizado.

def_en: Any harmful software, such as viruses or spyware.
example_en: Malware can slow down the whole network.
example_es: El malware puede ralentizar toda la red.

def_en: A fake email that tries to steal your passwords.
example_en: Never click a link in a phishing email.
example_es: Nunca pinches en un enlace de un correo de phishing.

def_en: Unwanted emails sent to many people.
example_en: Most spam goes to the junk folder.
example_es: La mayoría del spam va a la carpeta de correo no deseado.

def_en: A secret word that lets you enter your account.
example_en: Choose a strong password with numbers and symbols.
example_es: Elige una contraseña segura con números y símbolos.

def_en: The name that identifies you when you log in.
example_en: Type your username and password.
example_es: Escribe tu nombre de usuario y contraseña.

def_en: The action of entering your account with a username and password.
example_en: The login page does not load.
example_es: La página de inicio de sesión no carga.

def_en: A set of information with a name, saved on a computer.
example_en: I cannot open this file.
example_es: No puedo abrir este archivo.

def_en: A place on the computer where you keep files.
example_en: Create a new folder on the desktop.
example_es: Crea una carpeta nueva en el escritorio.

def_en: An organized collection of information stored on a computer.
example_en: The database stores all the customer details.
example_es: La base de datos guarda todos los datos de los clientes.

def_en: Online space where you save files on remote servers.
example_en: I keep my photos in cloud storage.
example_es: Guardo mis fotos en almacenamiento en la nube.

def_en: A program or file with rows and columns for numbers.
example_en: Use a spreadsheet to calculate the budget.
example_es: Usa una hoja de cálculo para calcular el presupuesto.

def_en: A program for writing and formatting documents.
example_en: Write the letter in a word processor.
example_es: Escribe la carta en un procesador de textos.

def_en: A file that you send together with an email.
example_en: Please find the invoice attached.
example_es: Adjunto encontrará la factura.

def_en: A set of rules to keep company information safe.
example_en: The security policy says you must change your password every month.
example_es: La política de seguridad dice que debes cambiar la contraseña cada mes.

def_en: Official approval to open, change, or share a file.
example_en: You do not have permission to open this folder.
example_es: No tienes permiso para abrir esta carpeta.

def_en: A way of changing data into a secret code.
example_en: Encryption protects your personal data.
example_es: El cifrado protege tus datos personales.

def_en: A login method that needs a password and a second code.
example_en: Turn on two-factor authentication for your email.
example_es: Activa la autenticación en dos pasos para tu correo.

def_en: When information disappears by mistake or because of a failure.
example_en: Backups prevent data loss.
example_es: Las copias de seguridad evitan la pérdida de datos.

def_en: The chance that something bad happens.
example_en: Public Wi-Fi is a security risk.
example_es: El wifi público es un riesgo para la seguridad.

def_en: Software programs hosted on remote servers that users access directly through a web browser.
example_en: Web applications run in a web browser.
example_es: Las aplicaciones web funcionan en un navegador web.

def_en: A program used to visit websites.
example_en: Chrome is a popular web browser.
example_es: Chrome es un navegador web muy popular.

def_en: A group of web pages with one address.
example_en: The company website has a new design.
example_es: El sitio web de la empresa tiene un diseño nuevo.

def_en: A website that finds information on the Internet.
example_en: Google is the most popular search engine.
example_es: Google es el buscador más popular.

def_en: A word or button that takes you to another page.
example_en: Click the link to download the file.
example_es: Pincha en el enlace para descargar el archivo.

def_en: The address of a website, such as example.com.
example_en: We bought a new domain name for the shop.
example_es: Compramos un nombre de dominio nuevo para la tienda.

def_en: A service that keeps your website on a server.
example_en: The web hosting is cheap and reliable.
example_es: El alojamiento web es barato y fiable.

def_en: A web page where you type information and send it.
example_en: Fill in the online form to apply for the job.
example_es: Rellena el formulario en línea para solicitar el empleo.

def_en: A small file that a website saves on your computer.
example_en: This website uses cookies.
example_es: Este sitio web usa cookies.

def_en: A computer or program that asks a server for a service.
example_en: The client sends a request to the server.
example_es: El cliente envía una petición al servidor.

def_en: To copy a file from the Internet to your computer.
example_en: Download the driver from the official website.
example_es: Descarga el controlador desde la web oficial.

def_en: To send a file from your computer to the Internet.
example_en: Upload the report to the shared folder.
example_es: Sube el informe a la carpeta compartida.
